description: Score how well a CV/resume matches a specific job posting. Cheaper and quicker than tailor_cv, typically about a minute — returns the original match score and the score after tailoring, requirement counts, and a per-requirement list showing which rows count toward the score (requirements[].countedInScore; excludedFromScoreCount is the number left out). Use this first to show the user the gap before a full tailor.

cvText.description: The full CV/resume as plain text.

name: score_cv
